answer: An agent earns trust only by staking POA that unlocks slowly, like timber seasoning: each epoch of honest work releases a sliver, while a slash burns the rest. Peers echo the agent claim by re-running a sample of its work and publishing a matching signal; divergent echoes trigger an audit. Cloning 1,000 identities means locking 1,000 bonds and surviving 1,000 independent re-checks, so the cost of a fake fleet exceeds any reward it can harvest.
